passages.text: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you— and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you to defeat them, then you must devote them to complete destruction. Make no treaty with them and show them no mercy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will bring you into the land.
You are going there to take possession of it.
The LORD will drive out many nations before you.
These nations are the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
There are seven nations.
These nations are larger than you.
These nations are stronger than you.
The LORD your God will give these nations into your hands.
You will defeat them.
You must destroy them completely.
Do not make a treaty with them.
Do not show them mercy.
passages.original: כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה בָא־ שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ וְנָשַׁ֣ל גּֽוֹיִם־ רַבִּ֣ים׀ מִפָּנֶ֡יךָ הַֽחִתִּי֩ וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֨י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֜י וְהַכְּנַעֲנִ֣י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֗י וְהַֽחִוִּי֙ וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י שִׁבְעָ֣ה גוֹיִ֔ם רַבִּ֥ים וַעֲצוּמִ֖ים מִמֶּֽךָּ׃ וּנְתָנָ֞ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ וְהִכִּיתָ֑ם הַחֲרֵ֤ם תַּחֲרִים֙ אֹתָ֔ם לֹא־ תִכְרֹ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם בְּרִ֖ית וְלֹ֥א תְחָנֵּֽם׃

passages.text: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons, because they will turn your sons away from following Me to serve other gods. Then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and He will swiftly destroy you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He commands you not to intermarry with the nations in the land.
Do not give your daughter to their son.
Do not take their daughter for your son.
If you intermarry, they will turn your children away from following the LORD.
Your children will serve other gods.
Then the LORD will become angry with you.
He will quickly destroy you.
passages.original: וְלֹ֥א תִתְחַתֵּ֖ן בָּ֑ם בִּתְּךָ֙ לֹא־ תִתֵּ֣ן לִבְנ֔וֹ וּבִתּ֖וֹ לֹא־ תִקַּ֥ח לִבְנֶֽךָ׃ כִּֽי־ יָסִ֤יר אֶת־ בִּנְךָ֙ מֵֽאַחֲרַ֔י וְעָבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְחָרָ֤ה אַף־ יְהוָה֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וְהִשְׁמִידְךָ֖ מַהֵֽר׃

passages.text: Instead, this is what you are to do to them: tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their idols in the fire.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to act against the nations in the land.
God told the Israelites what to do to the nations' religious objects.
Tear down their altars.
Smash their sacred pillars.
Cut down their Asherah poles.
Burn their idols in the fire.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אִם־ כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּ֙ לָהֶ֔ם מִזְבְּחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם תִּתֹּ֔צוּ וּמַצֵּבֹתָ֖ם תְּשַׁבֵּ֑רוּ וַאֲשֵֽׁירֵהֶם֙ תְּגַדֵּע֔וּן וּפְסִילֵיהֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרְפ֥וּן בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for His prized possession out of all peoples on the face of the earth.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
You are a people holy to the LORD your God.
The LORD your God chose you.
He chose you to be His special possession.
He chose you out of all the peoples on the face of the earth.
passages.original: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּךָ֞ בָּחַ֣ר׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ לִהְי֥וֹת לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה מִכֹּל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ס

passages.text: The LORD did not set His affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than the other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD chose you.
The LORD loved you.
He did not choose you because you were many.
You were not the largest nation.
You were the fewest of all peoples.
The LORD did not set His affection on you because of your numbers.
He chose you even though you were small among all nations.
passages.original: לֹ֣א מֵֽרֻבְּכֶ֞ם מִכָּל־ הָֽעַמִּ֗ים חָשַׁ֧ק יְהוָ֛ה בָּכֶ֖ם וַיִּבְחַ֣ר בָּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אַתֶּ֥ם הַמְעַ֖ט מִכָּל־ הָעַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: But because the LORD loved you and kept the oath He swore to your fathers, He brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD loved you.
The LORD kept the oath He swore to your fathers.
Because of His love and His promise, the LORD acted.
The LORD brought you out of Egypt.
He used His mighty hand to do this.
He redeemed you from the house of slavery.
He rescued you from the power of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
passages.original: כִּי֩ מֵֽאַהֲבַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה אֶתְכֶ֗ם וּמִשָּׁמְר֤וּ אֶת־ הַשְּׁבֻעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּע֙ לַאֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם הוֹצִ֧יא יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֑ה וַֽיִּפְדְּךָ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים מִיַּ֖ד פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion for a thousand generations of those who love Him and keep His commandments.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD alone is God.
The LORD is faithful.
The LORD keeps His covenant.
The LORD shows loving devotion.
He does this for those who love Him.
He does this for those who keep His commandments.
He keeps His covenant and loving devotion for a thousand generations.
passages.original: וְיָ֣דַעְתָּ֔ כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים הָאֵל֙ הַֽנֶּאֱמָ֔ן שֹׁמֵ֧ר הַבְּרִ֣ית וְהַחֶ֗סֶד לְאֹהֲבָ֛יו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֹתוֹ לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: But those who hate Him He repays to their faces with destruction; He will not hesitate to repay to his face the one who hates Him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is faithful.
The LORD repays those who hate Him.
He repays them directly.
He destroys them.
He does not delay.
He repays each person who hates Him to his face.
passages.original: וּמְשַׁלֵּ֧ם לְשֹׂנְאָ֛יו אֶל־ פָּנָ֖יו לְהַאֲבִיד֑וֹ לֹ֤א יְאַחֵר֙ לְשֹׂ֣נְא֔וֹ אֶל־ פָּנָ֖יו יְשַׁלֶּם־ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances that I am giving you to follow this day.
passages.sermon:
God gave commandments, statutes, and ordinances to His people.
God gave these instructions through Moses.
God commands you to keep these commandments, statutes, and ordinances.
God commands you to do them today.
passages.original: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֨ אֶת־ הַמִּצְוָ֜ה וְאֶת־ הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם לַעֲשׂוֹתָֽם׃פ

passages.text: If you listen to these ordinances and keep them carefully, then the LORD your God will keep His covenant and the loving devotion that He swore to your fathers.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD made a covenant with your fathers.
The LORD swore to show loving devotion to your fathers.
You must listen to these ordinances.
You must keep these ordinances carefully.
If you listen and keep them,
then the LORD your God will keep His covenant with you.
The LORD your God will keep His loving devotion to you.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ עֵ֣קֶב תִּשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֤ת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְשָׁמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לְךָ֗ אֶֽת־ הַבְּרִית֙ וְאֶת־ הַחֶ֔סֶד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: He will love you and bless you and multiply you. He will bless the fruit of your womb and the produce of your land—your grain, new wine, and oil, the young of your herds and the lambs of your flocks—in the land that He swore to your fathers to give you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God will love you.
He will bless you.
He will make you many.
He will bless your children.
He will bless the crops that grow in your land.
He will bless your grain.
He will bless your new wine.
He will bless your oil.
He will bless the young animals born to your herds.
He will bless the lambs born to your flocks.
He will do all this in the land.
He promised this land to your fathers.
He swore to give it to you.
passages.original: וַאֲהֵ֣בְךָ֔ וּבֵרַכְךָ֖ וְהִרְבֶּ֑ךָ וּבֵרַ֣ךְ פְּרִֽי־ בִטְנְךָ֣ וּפְרִֽי־ אַ֠דְמָתֶךָ דְּגָ֨נְךָ֜ וְתִֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֗ךָ שְׁגַר־ אֲלָפֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֔ךָ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: You will be blessed above all peoples; among you there will be no barren man or woman or livestock.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God promises to bless Israel more than any other people.
No man among you will be barren.
No woman among you will be barren.
No animal among your livestock will be barren.
passages.original: בָּר֥וּךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה מִכָּל־ הָעַמִּ֑ים לֹא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה בְךָ֛ עָקָ֥ר וַֽעֲקָרָ֖ה וּבִבְהֶמְתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness. He will not lay upon you any of the terrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but He will inflict them on all who hate you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will remove all sickness from you.
You knew terrible diseases in Egypt.
The LORD will not put these diseases on you.
The LORD will give these diseases to all who hate you.
passages.original: וְהֵסִ֧יר יְהוָ֛ה מִמְּךָ֖ כָּל־ חֹ֑לִי וְכָל־ מַדְוֵי֩ מִצְרַ֨יִם הָרָעִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֗עְתָּ לֹ֤א יְשִׂימָם֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּנְתָנָ֖ם בְּכָל־ שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God will deliver to you. Do not look on them with pity. Do not worship their gods, for that will be a snare to you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD your God will give you certain peoples.
You must destroy all these peoples.
Do not show them pity.
Do not worship their gods.
Their gods will be a trap for you.
passages.original: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָֽעַמִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ לֹא־ תָחֹ֥ס עֵֽינְךָ֖ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְלֹ֤א תַעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ מוֹקֵ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: You may say in your heart, “These nations are greater than we are; how can we drive them out?”
passages.sermon: You may think this in your heart.\r\nYou may say, “These nations are greater than we are.”\r\nYou may ask, “How can we drive them out?”
passages.original: כִּ֤י תֹאמַר֙ בִּלְבָ֣בְךָ֔ רַבִּ֛ים הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֵיכָ֥ה אוּכַ֖ל לְהוֹרִישָֽׁם׃

passages.text: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt: the great trials that you saw, the signs and wonders, and the mighty hand and outstretched arm by which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God is with you.
He is powerful and faithful.
Do not be afraid of these nations.
Remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh.
Remember what He did to all Egypt.
You saw great trials with your own eyes.
You saw signs and wonders.
You saw the LORD’s mighty hand.
You saw His outstretched arm.
The LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by His power.
The LORD your God will act the same way for you now.
He will do this to all the peoples you fear.
passages.original: לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א מֵהֶ֑ם זָכֹ֣ר תִּזְכֹּ֗ר אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְפַרְעֹ֖ה וּלְכָל־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ הַמַּסֹּ֨ת הַגְּדֹלֹ֜ת אֲשֶׁר־ רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְהָאֹתֹ֤ת וְהַמֹּֽפְתִים֙ וְהַיָּ֤ד הַחֲזָקָה֙ וְהַזְּרֹ֣עַ הַנְּטוּיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצִֽאֲךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כֵּֽן־ יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לְכָל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה יָרֵ֖א מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet against them until even the survivors hiding from you have perished.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will act for you.
The LORD will send the hornet against your enemies.
The hornet will attack them.
Some of your enemies will try to hide from you.
Some of your enemies will survive at first.
The hornet will keep attacking them.
The hornet will attack until all the survivors are gone.
The hornet will attack until all those hiding from you are gone.
passages.original: וְגַם֙ אֶת־ הַצִּרְעָ֔ה יְשַׁלַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בָּ֑ם עַד־ אֲבֹ֗ד הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֛ים וְהַנִּסְתָּרִ֖ים מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Do not be terrified by them, for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.
passages.sermon:
God is with you.
God is the LORD your God.
God is great.
God is awesome.
Do not be terrified by them.
passages.original: לֹ֥א תַעֲרֹ֖ץ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בְּקִרְבֶּ֔ךָ אֵ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל וְנוֹרָֽא׃

passages.text: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you little by little. You will not be enabled to eliminate them all at once, or the wild animals would multiply around you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is great and awesome.
The LORD is among you.
The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you.
He will do this little by little.
You will not be able to destroy all the nations at once.
If you destroy them too quickly, wild animals will become too many around you.
passages.original: וְנָשַׁל֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛ל מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ מְעַ֣ט מְעָ֑ט לֹ֤א תוּכַל֙ כַּלֹּתָ֣ם מַהֵ֔ר פֶּן־ תִּרְבֶּ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃

passages.text: But the LORD your God will give them over to you and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is with you.
The LORD will give your enemies to you.
The LORD will throw your enemies into great confusion.
The LORD will do this until your enemies are destroyed.
passages.original: וּנְתָנָ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וְהָמָם֙ מְהוּמָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽם׃

passages.text: He will hand their kings over to you, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand against you; you will annihilate them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God will act for you.
He will hand the kings of these nations over to you.
You will destroy their names from under heaven.
No one will be able to stand against you.
You will completely destroy them.
passages.original: וְנָתַ֤ן מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת־ שְׁמָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם לֹֽא־ יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ בְּפָנֶ֔יךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִֽדְךָ֖ אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
He commands you.
You must burn the images of their gods with fire.
Do not desire the silver on these images.
Do not desire the gold on these images.
Do not take the silver or gold for yourself.
If you take it, you will be trapped by it.
These images are detestable to the LORD your God.
passages.original: פְּסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרְפ֣וּן בָּאֵ֑שׁ לֹֽא־ תַחְמֹד֩ כֶּ֨סֶף וְזָהָ֤ב עֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ לָ֔ךְ פֶּ֚ן תִּוָּקֵ֣שׁ בּ֔וֹ כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: And you must not bring any detestable thing into your house, or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. You are to utterly detest and abhor it, because it is set apart for destruction.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Israel to destroy the idols and images of the nations.
These idols are detestable to the LORD.
Do not bring any detestable thing into your house.
If you bring it in, you will be set apart for destruction like it.
You must completely detest it.
You must utterly abhor it.
It is set apart for destruction.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ תָבִ֤יא תֽוֹעֵבָה֙ אֶל־ בֵּיתֶ֔ךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ חֵ֖רֶם כָּמֹ֑הוּ שַׁקֵּ֧ץ׀ תְּשַׁקְּצֶ֛נּוּ וְתַעֵ֥ב׀ תְּֽתַעֲבֶ֖נּוּ כִּי־ חֵ֥רֶם הֽוּא׃פ
